name: @ci/capacitor-local-llm
description: Capacitor plugin (Android-only) for on-device LLM inference via Google's LiteRT-LM. Lets the mobile shell answer prompts fully offline once a model is downloaded and the device clears the RAM/storage floor; @ci/common's nativeBridge.ts (generateOffline) falls back to the CI-Server /api/llm/generate endpoint otherwise. No ios/ folder — this is a supported partial-platform Capacitor plugin.
